svg.text: Everything hangs off XIAO-ESP32S3-cam. XIAO-ESP32S3-lora gets nothing but the two battery wires.
Viewed from above, USB-C to the left. The battery never touches the breadboard — see the note at the foot.
headers point DOWN, into the board
red → BAT+ pad, underside of BOTH XIAOs
black → BAT− pad, underside of BOTH XIAOs
There is no battery connector on a XIAO, and the
pads are unreachable once the expansion board is on.
Reversed polarity destroys the module instantly.
Two battery wires and nothing else.
a column of five is one node — a jumper one row
down from a pin is the same connection
+3V3 — out of the XIAO's pin 12, then to both sensors
GND — the XIAO's pin 13, the sensors, the buzzer
SDA — D4. One wire, both sensors
SCL — D5. One wire, both sensors
D0 — drives the piezo directly. No supply wire
battery — soldered to BAT pads, never to the board
Without it every reset is still caught and named.
With it the CSV also carries the shape of the sag.
Generated by hardware/scripts/gen_breadboard_svg.py — edit the script, not the SVG. Pin orders from docs/module-pinouts.md; connections from docs/bench-wiring.md.
